ms.promise: This milestone will produce a publicly accessible location (e.g. within the Catalyst Public Gitbook or somewhere similar and suitable) where the IOG Catalyst Team's Catalyst Fund Operations deliverables will be published monthly along with status updates and progress reports.
ms.criteria: The location is publicly accessible and includes the list of deliverables, reports, and updates that will be published there each month.
ms.report:
First milestone required to produce a publicly accessible location (e.g. within the Catalyst Public Gitbook or somewhere similar and suitable) where the IOG Catalyst Team's Catalyst Fund Operations deliverables will be published monthly along with status updates and progress reports. The Catalyst Team opted for leveraging existing Knowledge Base - docs.projectcatalyst.io GitBook instead of creating a new location. This is to keep information in one place for community to have an easy access to. Because Fund campaigns spans over course of several months, the team will periodically update the milestone pages on this GitBook to demonstrate progress in advance of formal Proof of Achievements.
Acceptance criteria of M1 was to ensure that this information will be publicly accessible and will includes list of relevant deliverables, reports, updates. This is now satisfied with the update to https://docs.projectcatalyst.io/catalyst-team-deliverables/f10-catalyst-fund-operation via new section for tracking progress. Also cadence of updates are targeted to be done continuously as it becomes available but at least once a month. The latest update timestamp for each section of Operations Proposal will be also shared at the bottom of these pages to communicate this efficiently.

ms.report:
Addressing Reviewer comments:
1. The tracker https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Zb_eNDp8iiXcJm7qnaogTUujyH9edQAKCu7bMqkUAWQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0 still registers activity in progress for a significant number of funded proposals. Therefore, F13 execution and onboarding of approved projects is still active and in process.
It’s challenging to achieve 100% completion due to factors beyond Catalyst’s control. Many projects face delays or don’t initiate required steps for various reasons outside of our team's control, such as their own legal issues, own project team challenges, or unresolved prior commitments that result in onboarding hold [previously incomplete projects, lack of PoA progression in a timely manner, etc].
Projects typically have 60 days to complete onboarding after results are announced. However, we are now entering a 90-day period, which is more time than usual. While we cannot indefinitely hold responsibility for outcomes beyond this timeframe, these challenges become part of the ongoing Catalyst Network management where we attempt to continue working through them whenever project teams provide necessary input to progress.
Our goal is not to cancel projects outright but to give them every opportunity to succeed. However, some may still face cancellation if they cannot overcome their challenges. The success of these projects largely depends on the cooperation and efforts of the project teams.
2. Please note that there were no Challenge Teams in Fund 13.
Regarding the challenge teams previously responsible for “proof of life” verification have transitioned their responsibilities to a formal due diligence platform, Sumsub, in collaboration with the compliance team. This upgrade was implemented to professionalise Catalyst, streamline operations, and accelerate compliance processes while adhering to best practice regulatory standards.

During the development of the Fund10 proposal, the Catalyst team noticed that prominent institutions in the web3 space often create materials to facilitate meaningful discussions around data. Historically, Catalyst has produced a significant amount of publicly available data, but few have made efforts to interpret it effectively. With this deliverable, the Catalyst team aimed to create a high-quality report that clearly communicates the impact and outcomes of collective efforts by the Cardano community through the Catalyst program.
To achieve this, the team established a dedicated section on the projectcatalyst.io website as a central repository for current and future reports. In July 2024, an interim report was published, which became the foundational blueprint for subsequent publications. 
The interim report is available via:
・https://projectcatalyst.io/reports/horizons.pdf

ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Milestone Reviewers,
It gives us great pleasure to share that the Catalyst Team officially submit the final Catalyst Fund Operations deliverables to you the community milestone reviewers for formal approval and sign-off.
Your role alongside the dozens of community milestone reviewers has been critical to the success of this project. 
Together, your ethics and accountability have helped to verify an impressive 2,695 milestones, resulting in 673 completed projects since Q4 2023 alone. Your diligent work in the background and commitment to high standards and transparency have been instrumental in achieving this outstanding level of progress for the Cardano ecosystem.
Through your efforts, the milestone-based funding model is an opportunity for Catalyst to set industry benchmarks, fostering trust in decentralized ecosystems, integrity in web3 voting and capital allocation, and creating genuine impact within the Cardano ecosystem.
Your meticulous oversight and the countless hours dedicated to ensuring project outcomes are verifiable have profoundly strengthened the foundation and reputation of Project Catalyst and Cardano more widely. 
Thank you for your extraordinary dedication, expertise, and continued support. Your contributions are deeply valued and have been pivotal in shaping the ongoing evolution of decentralized innovation funding, governance, and the highest potential for human collaboration. 
With gratitude and appreciation,
The Catalyst Team
